liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments rose by {{cash_like.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_like@FY2025}}, taking cash liquidity to revenue up by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}.
Debt due within one year rose by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2025}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2025}}, so cash liquidity covers the near-term maturities only in part and the balance depends on refinancing.

Free cash flow after lease payments rose by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2025}}, but at {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2025}} of debt it was broadly unchanged and leaves little cash for debt holders once leases are paid.

Customer prepayments rose: contract liabilities increased by {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2025}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2025}}, and advance ticket cover rose by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2025}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}}, so a larger share of liquidity is cash received for future travel.

watch_items.text: Leverage: net leverage rose by {{net_leverage.change@FY2025}} to {{net_leverage@FY2025}}, the weakest of the low-cost peer group ({{net_leverage.peer_rank@FY2025}}) and well above the peer median of {{net_leverage.peer_median@FY2025}}.
Cash generation: FFO to debt fell by {{ffo_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{ffo_to_debt@FY2025}}, below the peer median of {{ffo_to_debt.peer_median@FY2025}}, as FFO declined by {{ffo.change@FY2025}}.

Maturities: debt due within one year rose by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2025}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2025}} against cash and cash-like investments of {{cash_like@FY2025}}, so refinancing risk is concentrated in the near term.

Customer prepayments: advance ticket cover of {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}} is the highest of the peer group ({{advance_ticket_cover.peer_rank@FY2025}}), so liquidity relies on cash received for future travel.
